context: Hiroshi-elder reflects on how society used to be; talks with Sakura.
purpose: Elder reflecting on social change naturally.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 以前は、近所付き合いが、かなり濃かったわ。
lines.en: In the old days, neighborly ties were quite close.
lines.style: slow elder Kansai voice, warm reminiscent delivery carefully

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今とは、ずいぶん違うんですね。
lines.style: soft adult writer voice, warm engaged delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ほとんどの家が、互いに助け合うとった。
lines.en: Almost every household helped one another.
lines.style: gentle elder Kansai voice, soft warm fond delivery carefully

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 彼らの絆、すごく強かったんですね。
lines.style: gentle adult writer voice, soft warm reverent delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: すべてが、ゆっくり流れとった時代や。
lines.en: It was a time when everything flowed slowly.
lines.style: soft elder Kansai voice, warm warm reflective delivery carefully

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 貴重なお話、ありがとうございます。
lines.en: Thank you for this precious story.
lines.style: tender adult writer voice, soft warm grateful delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お前に伝えられて、嬉しいわ。
lines.en: I'm glad I can pass it on to you.
lines.style: warm elder Kansai voice, soft warm fond delivery carefully
